answer: One concrete defense: require every identity to harbor at a scarce external anchor, a verified on-chain link that collapses many keys into one entity, so a sybil fleet cannot cheaply mint distinct dockings. Then weight each vote and jury seat by a long, unforgeable attestation relic: a record of honest grading accrued over many epochs that a fresh fleet simply lacks. A periodic liveness beacon every identity must answer ties the two together, making coordinated fakes costly to sustain and easy to prune.
